name: AlgZoo RNN 2nd_argmax M32,8 (seed 2)
arch:
A one-layer recurrent network with ReLU and no biases. It reads a sequence of 10 real numbers, one per step, into a hidden state of 16 units, and outputs 10 numbers read from the final state.
  h_0 = 0;  h_t = relu(x_t * W_x + h_(t-1) @ W_h)   W_x: 1 x 16, W_h: 16 x 16
  out = h_10 @ W_o                                   W_o: 16 x 10
432 parameters. The output is a score per class; the network's decision is the largest.
context: The inputs are independent standard-normal numbers. Output class i stands for position i of the sequence (0-based).

tensor_desc.W_h: recurrent weights (row = from unit, column = to unit)
tensor_desc.W_o: readout (row = hidden unit, column = output class)

answer.detail: AlgZoo 2nd_argmax, hidden 32, length 8, seed 2; accuracy 0.9929 on 8000 standard-normal inputs.

domain.text: The network is used on sequences of 10 independent standard-normal numbers (a fixed sample of 8000).

tensors.desc: recurrent weights (row = from unit, column = to unit)

tensors.name: W_o
tensors.desc: readout (row = hidden unit, column = output class)
